title: Mob Loot Tweaks
description: Tweaks a few mob loot tables
body:
Modifies a few mob loot tables to give them a useful drop
frog - slimeballs
goat - mutton/string
camel - leather
fox - sweet berries
ocelot - string
turtle - scute with wither skull chances
ravager - leather
warden - echo shard
husk - sand
piglin - rare gold ingot, uncommon gold nugget
piglin brute - rare ancient debris, uncommon gold ingot, common gold nugget
elder guardian - rare heart of the sea, more drops than regular guardians
wither - wither roses
